evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?' — asked after full logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said no concern (after brief transcription confusion) — 15/15 via the no-concern-raised exception.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Explicit pay-less-if-faster framing ('you only pay for how long it will take after the minimum, so the shorter it will be the lower the cost'); missing rate/experience, self-prep tip, and a true fair-check (rep asked 'does that make sense?' as a billing-mechanics check, not a close-the-loop fairness question).

top_strength: Delivered all three key differentiators cleanly (damage coverage, meet-your-mover, on-time guarantee) and handled a firm price objection at the end gracefully, without any pressure.
coaching_note: No explicit close ask was made — the customer declined on price before the rep could ask, but building in an ask earlier (or a value-anchor before the number lands) might have changed the outcome.
